judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending S.J.Res. 13 to the President to cancel the federal bank rule ending fast automatic approval and short-form applications for mergers. The House passed it 220-207.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending S.J.Res. 13 to the President to cancel the federal bank rule ending fast automatic approval and short-form applications for mergers. The House passed it 220-207.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending S.J.Res. 31 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency rule requiring plants that lower their federal pollution category to keep controlling dangerous air pollutants that last and build up in living things. The House passed it 216-212.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending S.J.Res. 31 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency rule requiring plants that lower their federal pollution category to keep controlling dangerous air pollutants that last and build up in living things. The House passed it 216-212.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 88 to the President, revoking the federal permission for California rules requiring more low- and zero-emission new cars. The Senate passed it 51-44.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 88 to the President, which revoked the federal permission for California rules requiring more low- and zero-emission new cars. The Senate passed it 51-44.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 87 to the President, revoking the federal permissions for California's truck-emission warranty rules and zero-emission truck and fleet rules. The Senate passed it 51-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 87 to the President, which revoked the federal permissions for California's truck-emission warranty rules and zero-emission truck and fleet rules. The Senate passed it 51-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 2483, the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act of 2025, which renewed federal substance use disorder, overdose prevention, and mental health programs through 2030. The House passed it 366-57.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 2483, the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act of 2025, which renewed federal substance use disorder, overdose prevention, and mental health programs through 2030. The House passed it 366-57.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 2931, the Save SBA from Sanctuary Cities Act, which required the federal small-business agency to move any office located in a sanctuary area out of that area within 60 days. The House passed it 211-199.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 2931, the Save SBA from Sanctuary Cities Act, which required the federal small-business agency to move any office located in a sanctuary area out of that area within 60 days. The House passed it 211-199.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 2966, which limited Small Business Administration 7(a) and 504 loans to citizens, nationals, and green card holders, making people granted asylum and refugees unable to qualify. The House passed it 217-190.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 2966, which limited Small Business Administration 7(a) and 504 loans to citizens, nationals, and green card holders, making people granted asylum and refugees unable to qualify. The House passed it 217-190.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 884, which barred noncitizens from voting in District of Columbia elections and repealed the 2022 DC law that had allowed noncitizen residents to vote in local races. The House passed it 266-148.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 884, which barred noncitizens from voting in District of Columbia elections and repealed the 2022 DC law that had allowed noncitizen residents to vote in local races. The House passed it 266-148.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S. 331, the HALT Fentanyl Act, which permanently put fentanyl-related substances in the strictest federal drug category and gave them the same trafficking penalties as fentanyl. The House passed it 321-104, and it became law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S. 331, the HALT Fentanyl Act, which permanently put fentanyl-related substances in the strictest federal drug category and gave them the same trafficking penalties as fentanyl. The House passed it 321-104, and it became law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 2056, the District of Columbia Federal Immigration Compliance Act, which barred the District from limiting how its agencies share immigration status information or cooperate with federal immigration enforcement. The House passed it 224-194.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 2056, the District of Columbia Federal Immigration Compliance Act, which barred the District from limiting how its agencies share immigration status information or cooperate with federal immigration enforcement. The House passed it 224-194.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 875, which made driving while intoxicated or impaired a ground for barring an immigrant from entering the United States and for deporting one already here. The House passed it 246-160.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 875, which made driving while intoxicated or impaired a ground for barring an immigrant from entering the United States and for deporting one already here. The House passed it 246-160.
